performance.driver: Net sales for the six months ended June 30, 2026 for Industrial were $4.7 billion, an increase of 6.2% compared to 2025. The increase in sales primarily reflects a 5.0% increase in comparable sales and a 1.0% favorable impact from foreign currency. 23 During the second quarter of 2026, economic activity in the U.S. manufacturing sector, measured by PMI, marked its strongest monthly expansions since May 2022, supporting sales demand in our Industrial segment.
